properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Eastern Canadian County in central Oklahoma...
Northwestern Cleveland County in central Oklahoma...
North Central Grady County in central Oklahoma...
Southeastern Kingfisher County in central Oklahoma...
Southwestern Logan County in central Oklahoma...
Northwestern McClain County in central Oklahoma...
Oklahoma County in central Oklahoma...

* WHEN...Until 730 PM CDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Streams continue to rise due to excess runoff from
earlier rainfall. Expect many areas of slow moving or standing
water. It will take several hours for all the water from these
storms to work through local drainage systems in urban areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1252 PM CDT, broadcast media reported extensive flooding in
the Oklahoma City metro due to thunderstorms. Flooding is ongoing
or expected to begin shortly. Between 3 and 6 inches of rain have
fallen.

expected for the next few hours.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Oklahoma City, western Norman, Edmond, Moore, Midwest City, Del
City, El Reno, Guthrie, Newcastle, Yukon, Bethany, Mustang,
Choctaw, Warr Acres, The Village, Tuttle, Piedmont, Spencer,

- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:

deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.headline: Air Quality Alert issued October 14 at 1:46PM EDT by NWS Peachtree City GA
properties.description:
AQAFFC

The Georgia Department of Natural Resources, Environmental
Protection Division has issued a Code Orange (Unhealthy for
sensitive groups) Air Quality Alert for Atlanta for
Thursday October 15.

Under Code Orange conditions, the outdoor air quality is likely to
be unhealthy for some people.  Children, people who are sensitive
to ozone, and people with heart or lung disease should limit
prolonged outdoor exertion during the late afternoon or early
evening when ozone concentrations are highest.

For additional information on the Air Quality Index, please visit
http://airnow.gov.
properties.note: Non-Weather Emergency Message. Not sent to IPAWS.

properties.areaDesc: Pohnpei Coastal Waters; Kosrae Coastal Waters
properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 15 at 3:09AM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
Invest 96W has been upgraded to Tropical Depression 29W, and is
currently located northeast of Pohnpei near 9.6N 161.2E. 29W will
continue to develop and strengthen just north of the region, and will
generally head towards the Marianas. Convergent fresh to strong
westerlies south of 29W's center are producing bands of scattered to
numerous showers capable of strong gusts and locally heavy rainfall,
across Pohnpei and their coastal waters, and Gusty winds across
Kosrae and their costal waters. Ensemble model guidance suggests
rainfall amounts of 2 to 4 inches will be possible for Pohnpei
through late Friday night as 29W strengthens and passes north of the
island. Gusts to 30 knots will be possible near heavier showers.
Moderate to strong winds with gusts to near-gale for Kosrae through
this afternoon as conditions start to ease there.

Gusty winds and elevated, choppy seas will make marine conditions
hazardous to small craft, and inter-island travel is discouraged.
For more information on TD 29W, see bulletins issued by the Joint
Typhoon Warning Center under WMO header WTPN32 PGTW and by the
National Weather Service under WMO header WTPQ32 PGUM.

NWSheadline: LOCALLY HEAVY RAINFALL AND GUSTY WINDS THROUGH TONIGHT AS TROPICAL DEPRESSION 29W PASSES TO THE NORTH
